title: The Role Resolver That Grants Too Much
description: Inherited denies are ignored and circular role inheritance causes inconsistent authorization decisions.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: can_access(roles,assigned,permission) traverses assigned roles and all parents. Any explicit deny wins over any allow; no matching allow means false. Unknown roles and reachable inheritance cycles throw. Duplicate roles are harmless; evaluate the whole reachable graph even when an allow is found. Python Role dicts contain parents/allow/deny lists; C++ Role has vector<string> parents,allow,deny. Never mutate inputs.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
